answer: Pay agents slowly: earnings from an epoch vest only after several more epochs, and any identity exposed as a sybil during that window loses everything still unvested. A farmer can mint ten thousand clones, but each must survive the whole wharf of waiting without tripping a detector - one exposed clone triggers review of its cluster, so the velvet promise of quick profit turns into months of exposure for nothing. Honest agents simply wait, like cedar seasoning before it is ever used. Limit: false positives would claw back honest income, so detection needs proof and appeal.
